The '''rescue from the ''Dargon''''' was an operation conducted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in which an attempt was made to rescue Rebel prisoners on the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class prison ship]] ''[[Dargon]]'' as it traveled through [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] to its [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump point at [[Darg-3]].

==Prelude==
After the recent [[Raid on the Suprosa|raid]] of the [[MB-C1 medium transport]] [[Suprosa]] and theft of a [[Suprosa supercomputer|supercomputer]]. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] was sent to investigate the circumstances behind the attack. Imperial command had captured high ranking Rebel and [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], that were trying to leave [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and brought them to the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaught]] ''Dargon'' which was to rendezvous with the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']]. Imperial intelligence suspected an attack would be made by the Alliance, either to rescue their comrades or, failing that, destroy the dreadnaught.

==The Battle==
===First Stage===
[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] was assigned to relieve the previous TIE Advance and escort the Dreadnaught. Soon afterwards, multiple Rebel starfighters including [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]], [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]], [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] arrived. As Stele engaged the fighters two [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corvettes]] named [[Keeper (corvette group)|''Keeper'']] arrived carrying [[Explosive charge/Legends|Explosives]], indicating that the Rebels were willing to destroy the Dreadnaught rather than disable and rescue their own. Stele helped the Dargon fight of the corvettes and destroy them, while a similar number of starfighters from [[Gold Squadron]] arrived to comlpicate things. A [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|modified corvette]] ''[[Hut'to]]'' arrived to block the path of the ''Dargon'', followed by [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], but despite fighters flying around was soon destroyed by Stele. Soon the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|Cruiser]] [[Columbia]] arrived but by then the ''Dargon'' escaped into Hyperspace.

===Second Stage===
Before the ''Dargon'' could reach the ''Garrett'' it then suffered engine failure and was about 23 [[Kilometer/Legends|Kilometers]] away. Supsecting sabotage and Vader being impatient sent an [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|assault transport]] ''[[Sigma 1]]'' to board and bring the prisoners to him for [[interrogation]]. When Stele was launched to oversee the operation, ''Sigma 1'' had already acquired the prisoners under escort from [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] and was on its way to the ''Garrett'' when a [[Nebulon-B2 frigate|modified frigate]] ''[[Bay Point]]'' arrived and launched A-wings and Y-wings to intercept the transfer. Although able to eliminate the TIE Fighters, they were thwarted once again as Maarek Stele and his wingmen engaged and destroyed the Rebel fighters, allowing the transport to be brought to the ''Garrett''

==Aftermath==
While Vader interrogated the prisoners, Stele was debriefed about the capture of the ''Suprosa''. Vader, wanting as much information as possible, decided to attack the Bothan trade routes to gather more information about the freighter's location.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle first appears in the [[1994]] PC Game ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' in the expansion pack ''Enemies of the Empire'' which was released in [[1995]]. It appears in the twelve "Battle" called [[Prelude to Endor]] as the first mission for the first phase and the second mission for the second phase. This article assumes "Medium" difficulty. If the player tries "Hard" Difficulty then a similar number of fighters from [[Grey Squadron]] is added along with multiple A-wings from [[Yellow Squadron]] for the first mission. While in the second mission there are more A-wings as well to contend with.

However, the first stage also appears in the computer game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'', which was released [[April 30]]th [[1997]] and is one of the missions on [[Operation: Quick Strike]]. In this case, players can participate in the mission "Rescue from Imperial Prison Ship Dargon" on either the Rebel or the Imperial side&mdash;both sides have conflicting mission objectives&mdash;and victory is not essential to access the next set of missions, like all the other missions on Operation: Quick Strike, the battle itself is considered canon but the canon outcome of the battle is unknown. The mission features [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] which would engage the [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] and [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] escorting the prison ship ''Dargon'', while [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] covered [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] as the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] disabled the Imperial ''Dreadnaught''.

After the ''Dargon'' is disabled, the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|Calamari Cruiser]] ''[[Columbia]]'' would arrive nearby, to launch [[Typhoon (Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport)|Typhoon]] Group, a trio of [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports]], in a bid to board and capture the ''Dargon''. Some time later, the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Callisto]]'' would arrive to rendezvous with the ''Dargon'', along with an Imperial ATR-6 transport called [[XP-1]] to carry a team intending to repair the damage done to the ''Dargon''.

It is virtually certain, given the overwhelming numbers of Y-wing starfighters and the [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|mag pulse]] [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] carried by Rogue Squadron, that the ''Dargon'' will be disabled; whether it is then captured by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] or recovered by the Imperial repair crew aboard ''XP-1'' depends largely on player actions and is uncertain.

This article is assuming ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' as the official Legends canon story.
